learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the magic of mime and discover how your body language and facial expressions can tell an entire story without saying a single word!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Mime is a wonderful type of acting where you use only your face and body to talk to the audience. You become a living, breathing cartoon that tells a story purely through movement!
How you stand or move shows exactly how your character feels. Slumping your shoulders shows sadness or tiredness, while standing tall with a big smile shows confidence and joy.

Mime artists are like magicians who can make invisible things feel real! By pretending to touch a flat wall or pull a heavy rope, you make the audience believe the object is actually right there in your hands.

fun_activity.title: 📦 The Invisible Box Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend you are trapped inside an invisible glass box. Use your flat hands to feel the walls, the ceiling, and the floor, and try to act out how you would escape without making a sound!

quick_recap: ⭐ Mime relies entirely on physical movements to express thoughts and feelings.
⭐ You can create powerful stories and invisible objects just by using careful gestures and clear facial expressions.
